title: Switch the app language
description: Short XRP Mobile tutorial: change the app language from Settings. XRP Mobile ships fully translated in 13 languages, and the switch is instant. Your wallet, your keys and your balances are untouched.
lede: Your wallet does not have to be in English. XRP Mobile ships in 13 languages, and switching takes two taps.

steps.caption: Open Settings
steps.body: Tap the gear, and stay on General.

steps.caption: Tap App language
steps.body: Tap App language. This changes the app only. It does not touch your wallet, your keys or your balances.

steps.caption: Pick yours
steps.body: Pick yours from the list. Thirteen languages ship with the app, translated in full.

steps.caption: The whole app follows
steps.body: And the whole interface comes back in it, right away, with nothing to restart.
